svg.aria-label: The problem: When a risk issue is raised, the team that owns it fixes it and submits a claim that it is resolved. Before the issue can be closed, a reviewer has to confirm the claim is backed by evidence. That evidence usually sits in nested documents: files embedded inside other files, in mixed formats. Finding and checking it by hand took 3–4 weeks per issue.
